senses.gloss:
लीला लीला, f. (supposed by some to be a
corruption of क्रीडा; perhaps connected with rt.
1. लस् or with लेलाय), play, sport, diversion, amuse-
ment, pastime; wanton sport, amorous pastime
(shown in the imitation of a lover's gait, manner,
&c.), wantonness; mere sport or play, mere amuse-
ment, joking, frivolity, child's play, ease or facility
in doing anything, (लीलया, out of sport, sportively,
for amusement, as a mere joke, with the greatest
ease, without effort); sportive appearance, semblance,
dissembling, dissimulation, pretence, disguise, sham;
air, mien, manner; grace, beauty, charm, loveliness;
a species of metre, four times ¯˘˘¯˘˘¯˘˘¯˘˘
¯˘˘¯.
—लीला-कमल, अम्, n. a woman's toy-
lotus, a lotus-flower held in the hand as a plaything.
—लीला-कर, अस्, m. a particular metre.
—लीला-
कलह, अस्, m. a quarrel or dispute in play, sham-
fight, mock-fight.
—लीला-खेल, अस्, आ, अम्, moving
or sporting playfully, playful; (अम्, आ), n. f. a kind
of metre, four times ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
—लीलागार (˚ला-आग्˚) or लीला-गृह or लीला-गेह,
अम्, n. a pleasure-house, place of amusement or sport.
—लीलाङ्ग (˚ला-अन्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having graceful or
playful limbs (said of a bull &c.).
—लीलाचल (˚ला-
अच्˚), अस्, m., N. of a district.
—लीला-तनु, उस्, f. a
form assumed for mere sport or pleasure.
—लीला-
ताण्डव-पण्डित, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in sportive
dances (said of Śiva).
—लीला-तामरस, अम्, n. a
lotus-flower held in the hand as a plaything.
—लीला-
दग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, burnt to ashes or consumed
without effort.
—लीलाद्रि (˚ला-अद्˚), इस्, m. = लीला-
चल.
—लीला-नटन, अम्, n. a sportive dance.
—लीला-पद्म, अम्, n. a toy-lotus, (see लीला-क-
मल.)
—लीला-पर्वत, अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
—लीलाब्ज (˚ला-अब्˚), अम्, n. = लीला-कमल.
—ली-
लाभरण (˚ला-आभ्˚), अम्, n. a sham ornament (as
a bracelet made of a string of lotuses).
—लीला-
मधु-कर, अस्, m., N. of a drama.
—लीला-म-
नुष्य, अस्, m. a sham man, man in disguise, one
not really a man.
—लीला-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting
of play or amusement, playful, sportive, relating to
play or amusement.
—लीला-मात्रेण, ind. out of
mere sport, in mere play, without the least effort.
—लीला-मानुष-विग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, having a
human body merely for amusement, assuming the
shape of a man for a pretext or pretence; (अस्), m.
epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
—लीलाम्बुज (˚ला-अम्˚), अम्, n.
= लीला-कमल.
—लीलायुध (˚ला-आय्˚), आस्, m. pl.,
N. of a people, (perhaps for नीलायुध.)
—लीला-
रति, इस्, f. sportive amusement, sport, amusement.
—लीलारविन्द (˚ला-अर्˚), अम्, n. = लीला-कमल.
[]
—लीला-वज्र, अम्, n. an implement or instrument
shaped like a thunderbolt.
—लीला-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
possessed of grace or beauty, graceful, beautiful,
charming; (अती), f. a beautiful and charming woman,
a wanton woman; N. of Durgā; of the wife of the
Asura Maya; of a merchant's daughter (in the
Hitopadeśa); a kind of metre; N. of a section of
the Siddhānta-śiromaṇi; of a well known treatise
on arithmetic, algebra, and geometry by Bhāskara
Ācārya; of an elementary treatise on the Vaiśeṣika
philosophy (= न्याय-ल्˚, q. v.); of a work on medi-
cine.
—लीलावतार (˚ला-अव्˚), अस्, m. the descent (of
Viṣṇu on the earth) for his own amusement.
—ली-
लावधूत (˚ला-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, gracefully waved
about.
—लीला-वापी, f. a pleasure-tank or lake.
—लीला-
वेश्मन्, अ, n. a pleasure-house; [cf. लीलागार.]
—लीला-शुक, अस्, m. ‘pleasure-parrot,’ N. of the
poet Vilva-maṅgala.
—लीला-साध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to
be effected with ease.
—लीला-स्वात्म-प्रिय, अस्, m.,
N. of an author held in esteem by the Tāntrikas or
worshippers of Durgā.
—लीलोद्यान (˚ला-उद्˚), अम्,
n. a pleasure-garden, pleasure-grounds.

लीलाय, Nom. P. A. लीलायति, -यते, -यितुम्, to
play, sport, amuse one's self.

लीलायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, or लीलायमान, अस्, आ, अम्,
playing, sporting, dallying, sporting wantonly.

लीलायित, अस्, आ, अम्, done playfully or sportively,
written sportively; (अम्), n. play, sport, amusement.

लीलोपवती (?), f. a kind of metre, four times
